presets.name: Bare
presets.summary: No glasses, just eyes and mouth.
presets.description: Glasses appear on one avatar in ten by default. Off, three components become two, and every avatar in a set is built the same way. Worth knowing before you read the rest of these: what this style calls the background is the face. There is no separate skin group, so `backgroundColor` sets the complexion and the tile at once.

presets.name: Full Cast
presets.description: The opposite end of the same lever. The style ships fourteen frames, and at the default probability most of them are never seen.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.description: One warm ramp across the face and the features. Since the background is the complexion here, a sepia set commits everyone to the same four tones rather than leaving skin to the seed.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: No hue on the face or the features.
presets.description: Useful for a print stylesheet, a disabled state, or anywhere color would carry meaning it should not. Four steps of grey stand in for the eight skin tones, which is enough for the faces to stay distinguishable.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: One blue face for every avatar.
presets.description: A single color for the whole set, so nothing but the eye and mouth shapes tells two avatars apart. It commits everyone to the same complexion, which is the point here and would be a problem anywhere else.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Dusty faces instead of skin tones.
presets.description: Six tones that do not read as complexions at all. Useful when the avatars stand for accounts or machines rather than people.

presets.name: Electric
presets.description: The same idea past the end of the scale. On a 14 pixel grid a loud face carries much further down a list than a loud detail would.

presets.name: Cool
presets.description: Half the color wheel, and the counterpart to Warm. Two groups of accounts can be told apart by temperature without a second badge.

presets.name: Warm
presets.description: The other half of the same wheel.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.description: For dark interfaces. Eyes and mouth invert to pale, because the near-black features the style ships disappear on a dark face.
